description: This header file defines the DbusMgr class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, providing an interface for managing and accessing various NetworkManager DBus proxies and connections. It declares methods to obtain proxies for different network components such as devices, settings, IPv4/IPv6 configurations, and more.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class providing an interface to manage D-Bus proxies for NetworkManager components, including methods to retrieve proxies for devices, settings, connection, and network interfaces.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for the main NetworkManager.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for NetworkManager settings.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for a specific network connection identified by its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for a network device.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for wireless devices.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for IPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for IPv6 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for an active network connection.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for access points.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the GDBusConnection used by the DbusMgr.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for network device properties.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for DHCPv4 configuration.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for DHCPv6 configuration.
